acceptance_scope: Focused input serialization and checked-property repair only.

checks.input_order: All non-type/value/checked input attributes retain source order and precede type then value; this matches the pinned form oracle example.
checks.checked: The repair omits checked from setAttribute ordering and applies it as the live input.checked property. The regression expects no checked HTML attribute and checked:true in the controls snapshot.
checks.same_renderer_identity: The new form regression checks strict node identity and focus after a state update; a separate existing test checks keyed reorder identity.
checks.selection: The new form regression checks selectionStart 1, selectionEnd 4, selectionDirection backward after update.
checks.messages: The new regression checks input and change dispatch action/message payloads.
checks.red_green: The preserved red log fails at the expected initial input HTML order; the preserved green log records 4 passing Chromium tests.

n3_integration.status_at_review: Separate N3 four-app/five-fixture run was active; no current positive form receipt was available to this review.

review_method: Inspected current production/test source, raw attempt-06 form failure capture, R-DOM receipt, preserved pre-repair hashes, red log, and green log. Did not relaunch Chromium while N3's full integration run was active.
